description: This is a C source file implementing a device driver module for PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) testing, including proc filesystem interface functions for reading and writing driver states and configurations. It includes core functions for VR9 architecture and handles various debug and control commands via /proc entries.

methods.name: void proc_file_create(void)
methods.description: Creates /proc entries for driver control and memory access.

methods.name: void proc_file_delete(void)
methods.description: Removes the /proc entries created by proc_file_create.

methods.name: int __init ifx_ptm_test_init(void)
methods.description: Module initialization function that sets up proc entries.

methods.name: void __exit ifx_ptm_test_exit(void)
methods.description: Cleanup function that removes proc entries upon module unload.

methods.name: int proc_write_mem(struct file * file,const char * buf,unsigned long count,void * data)
methods.description: Handles write operations to /proc/driver/ifx_ptm/mem, supporting memory access commands.

methods.name: int proc_read_pp32(char * page,char ** start,off_t off,int count,int * eof,void * data)
methods.description: Handles read operations for the debugging interface, printing status of core 0..3.

methods.name: int proc_write_pp32(struct file * file,const char * buf,unsigned long count,void * data)
methods.description: Handles write commands to control the PRU cores and set breakpoints.

methods.name: int stricmp(const char * p1,const char * p2)
int strincmp(const char * p1,const char * p2,int n)
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison with length limit.

methods.name: int get_token(char ** p1,char ** p2,int * len,int * colon)
int get_number(char ** p,int * len,int is_hex)
methods.description: Parses numerical values from commands, supporting hex and decimal.

methods.name: void ignore_space(char ** p,int * len)
methods.description: Skips whitespace and delimiters in command parsing.
